note: Inter's symbol faces in fonts/app/inter-symbols/: harfbuzz subsets of fonts/inter-full.ttf, the full Inter (SIL OFL 1.1, no Reserved Font Name) of the build Google's Inter subsets were cut from, holding the code points it maps and no Google subset maps, but the excluded ones, one face per group of blocks. Each keeps the opsz and wght axes, the layout features and name records of Google's subsets (Inter's base forms) and the outlines of the full Inter, with the line box of src/i18n/font-metrics.ts baked in as in Google's Inter faces. sha256 and bytes are the digests of the WOFF2 files. Written by scripts/fonts/build-inter-symbol-faces.mts; checked by scripts/check-app-font.mts. Do not edit by hand.
selection: The code points the full Inter maps and no Google Inter subset (fonts/inter/) maps, but the excluded ones below; each goes to the first face whose blocks hold it.

excluded.name: private use
excluded.reason: Inter's alternate glyphs (such as G.1), which have no standard meaning.
excluded.unicodeRange: U+E000, U+E002-E05E, U+E06A-E0BD, U+E0C8-E0CC, U+E0DC-E0E6, U+E0F3-E0F5, U+E106, U+E109-E10A, U+E10C-E10F, U+E111-E113, U+E117-E118, U+E121-E122, U+E124, U+E12A-E15E, U+E163, U+E1C3, U+E1D2-E1DF, U+E1E1-E2DC, U+EE01-EE07, U+EE09-EE0A, U+EE0C-EE12, U+EE14, U+EE17, U+EE1D-EE45, U+EE47-EE84, U+EE87-EED6, U+EED8-EEE1, U+F6C3

excluded.name: combining marks
excluded.reason: A mark joins only a base of its own font, and a browser shapes a grapheme with one font, so a mark in a face of its own would never join a letter of the Google subsets. The device font keeps drawing them.

excluded.name: emoji presentation
excluded.reason: It draws with the emoji font by default.

excluded.name: enclosed alphanumerics
excluded.reason: Owner decision 2026-11-18: Inter has ① to ⑨, ⓪, Ⓐ to Ⓩ, ➀ to ➈ and the squared letters, but not ⑩, ⓐ or ➉, so a series would switch family midway. They stay with the families that draw them.

excluded.name: symbols a device font draws
excluded.reason: Owner decision 2026-11-18: ↩ ↪ ⏏ ❤ keep the look a device font gives them, which a phone may show as color emoji.

faces.name: spaces
faces.holds: The spaces (Zs) and the dashes U+2010-2015: a face of spaces alone has a glyf table of no bytes, which OTS refuses.

faces.name: punctuation
faces.holds: General Punctuation from U+2016, Spacing Modifier Letters, Supplemental Punctuation and U+A92E.

faces.name: arrows
faces.holds: Arrows, Supplemental Arrows-A, -B and -C, and the arrows of Miscellaneous Symbols and Arrows.

faces.name: math
faces.holds: Mathematical Operators, Supplemental Mathematical Operators and Miscellaneous Mathematical Symbols-A.

faces.name: letterlike
faces.holds: Letterlike Symbols, the Roman numerals and letters of Number Forms (U+2160-2188) and the baht sign.

faces.name: fractions
faces.holds: The fractions of Number Forms (U+2150-215F, U+2189), Superscripts and Subscripts.

faces.name: shapes
faces.holds: Geometric Shapes, Miscellaneous Symbols, Dingbats, the shapes of Miscellaneous Symbols and Arrows, Miscellaneous Technical and Control Pictures.
